# Ledco Plumbing — Full Reference

> Ledco Plumbing is a plumber in Seminole, Oklahoma, owned by Mickey Ledbetter. It repairs drains, water heaters, hidden leaks and sewer lines, and handles commercial plumbing, for homes and businesses in Seminole and Wewoka, OK. The office at 316 E Oak Ave is open Monday through Sunday, 7:00 AM to 5:00 PM.

## How to Reach Ledco Plumbing

Ledco Plumbing takes calls at (405) 257-3096 seven days a week from 7:00 AM to 5:00 PM. A sewer backup or a burst pipe is best reported by phone so the office hears about it right away. For other requests, the website has a request form on the home page, the Contact page and every service and service-area page.

## Services

### Drain Cleaning
URL: https://preview-ledco-plumbing.pageone.cloud/services/drain-cleaning/
Ledco Plumbing clears clogged and slow drains in Seminole and Wewoka homes and businesses, from a single bathroom sink to a main line that pushes water back up into the tub. The work covers kitchen and bathroom sinks, tubs, showers, toilets, laundry standpipes, floor drains and the main line they all empty into. A drain needs professional cleaning when it clogs again within days of plunging, when water rises in a second fixture, or when the toilet gurgles after another drain runs.

### Water Heater Repair & Installation
URL: https://preview-ledco-plumbing.pageone.cloud/services/water-heater-repair-installation/
Ledco Plumbing repairs water heaters that run cold, leak or rumble, and installs a new heater when the old tank is past saving, for homes and businesses in Seminole and Wewoka. Signs of a failing water heater are hot water running out sooner than it used to, rusty water, and a tank that pops and rumbles while it heats. Water pooling around the base is the most serious sign, because a tank that has rusted through cannot be patched. A heater is repaired when a replaceable part has failed and the tank is sound, and replaced when the tank leaks or is badly scaled.

### Leak Detection & Repair
URL: https://preview-ledco-plumbing.pageone.cloud/services/leak-detection-repair/
Ledco Plumbing finds hidden water leaks in walls, floors, slabs and yard lines, then repairs the pipe, for homes and businesses in Seminole and Wewoka. The clearest sign of a hidden leak is a water bill that rises with no change in use. Others are the sound of running water when every tap is off, a warm spot on a slab floor, stains or bubbling paint, and a soggy patch of yard. A meter test shows whether water is escaping: turn off every faucet and appliance and watch the meter for 15 minutes. If a pipe bursts, close the main water shutoff valve first, then call (405) 257-3096.

### Sewer Line Repair
URL: https://preview-ledco-plumbing.pageone.cloud/services/sewer-line-repair/
Ledco Plumbing repairs sewer lines that back up, leak or fill with roots, for homes and businesses in Seminole and Wewoka. An ordinary clog affects one fixture; a sewer line problem affects the whole house. Signs are a toilet that gurgles as the washer drains, water that rises in the tub after a flush, or the lowest drain in the house backing up. If several drains back up at once, stop using water and call (405) 257-3096.

### Commercial Plumbing
URL: https://preview-ledco-plumbing.pageone.cloud/services/commercial-plumbing/
Ledco Plumbing handles plumbing repair for Seminole and Wewoka businesses: restrooms, kitchen and floor drains, water heaters, hidden leaks and sewer lines. The office takes calls on Saturdays and Sundays, 7:00 AM to 5:00 PM, the same hours as weekdays. A business call goes fastest when the caller can give the address, who can let the plumber in, who approves the price, and exactly which fixtures are affected.

## Service Areas

Ledco Plumbing lists two service areas: Seminole, OK and Wewoka, OK. For an address elsewhere in Seminole County, the office confirms by phone whether a plumber can reach it.

### Seminole, OK
URL: https://preview-ledco-plumbing.pageone.cloud/service-areas/seminole-ok/
Seminole is the home base. The office is at 316 E Oak Ave, Seminole, OK 74868. All five services are offered to homes and businesses in town.

### Wewoka, OK
URL: https://preview-ledco-plumbing.pageone.cloud/service-areas/wewoka-ok/
Wewoka (ZIP 74884) is served from the Seminole office, about 10 miles away in a straight line. All five services are offered to homes, offices and shops in Wewoka.

Service-area overview: https://preview-ledco-plumbing.pageone.cloud/service-areas/

## Frequently Asked Questions

The full list of 18 questions is at https://preview-ledco-plumbing.pageone.cloud/faq/. Short answers to the most common ones:

**Which areas does Ledco Plumbing serve?**
Seminole and Wewoka, Oklahoma. For other addresses in Seminole County, call (405) 257-3096 to confirm.

**What are the hours?**
Monday through Sunday, 7:00 AM to 5:00 PM.

**Does Ledco Plumbing work on commercial properties?**
Yes. Commercial plumbing is one of its five services, covering restrooms, drains, water heaters, leaks and sewer lines for businesses in Seminole and Wewoka.

**What should I do when a pipe bursts?**
Close the main water shutoff valve, usually where the water line enters the house or inside the meter box near the street, then call (405) 257-3096.
